title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.97
exact_target: Can every positive rational occur exactly as a finite group’s automorphism-group order divided by its own order?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2606 (KOU-21.97). CC BY 4.0.

M. Tărnăuceanu and R. Molinier, Problem 21.97, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records an affirmative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
